thread:
sarah: Opening a PR to add the Nimbus2-13B model card + a short migration guide. Draft is at https://git.redwood/nimbus2/card-draft (WIP). Need: compat notes for q8/q4 variants, updated limits, small throughput bench, and SDK snippet changes. Assigning reviewers.
eli: Thanks — tagging in bench owners. We should include clear 'fallback' guidance for small-GPU (4GB quant) vs Dedicated.
marta: Can you paste the SDK snippet you'll want? I can sed the examples later for all languages.
sarah: Quick Python snippet (WIP):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate(model="nimbus2-13b", prompt="Summarize...", temperature=0.2)
print(resp.text)
```
chris: For compat notes: Nimbus2 has an attention pattern that breaks some older kernel fusions. Recommend quantized variants: `nimbus2-13b.q4f16` and `nimbus2-13b.q8_legacy` (q4 preferred for CPU fallbacks). Add a note: q8_legacy keeps slightly higher mem but better perf on A100.
eli: Benchmarks (initial): batch=1 latency ~95ms p50 on A100-80GB, throughput ~420 tok/s at batch=8, mem footprint ~18GB for q4; include machine details in card.
sarah: Good. Also need to update model catalog supported_variants: add `q4f16`, `q8_legacy`, `fp16` and set `max_sequence_length` to "4096" (was 2048). Ping devex for SDK breaking change: default `kv_cache` behavior changed.
devex-bot: devex-bot: Notifying SDK teams — please review snippet compatibility. Label: `sdk-snippet-review` added.
docs-bot: docs-bot: Added labels: needs-bench, needs-sdk-update. Assigned to @eli and @marta.
marta: I'll update examples across the snippets folder. Two ask: (1) show an example with streaming (since Nimbus2 supports chunked outputs) and (2) include note about prefix KV caching: `kv_cache=True` recommended for chat continuity.
chris: Migration note: users pinning `nimbus2-13b:latest` should be warned that quant suffixes are required for CPU runtimes. Recommend adding a small YAML migration snippet for infra teams.
sarah: Draft of YAML (short):
```yaml
model:
  name: nimbus2-13b.q4f16
  max_seq: 4096
  quant_profile: q4f16
```
eli: Minor editorial: under "limits" add per-request token cap of 2048 for Hosted (to avoid abuse) but allow Dedicated override. Also add note about burst autoscaling behaving differently with q8 variants.
sarah: I'll add that. Question for chris: can we include the tiny bench script we used? reproducibility is helpful.
chris: I'll drop a link to the bench script in the PR — it's in infra/benchmarks/nimbus2/bench-runner.sh. It includes config for A100 and for a 48GB edge GPU.
eli: After benches are added, I'll run the perf tables generator and paste the CSV into the card (or link to it). We should include p50/p95 and tokens/s.
marta: For SDK snippets, I'll change `RedwoodClient()` call to `Redwood()` per the new constructor name in SDK v2 and add `stream=True` example.
sarah: Perfect. Can someone volunteer to proof the compatibility paragraph? it needs simple language for enterprise customers.
eli: I'll take it. I'll check quant caveats and the allowed fallbacks list.
sarah: Thanks. Plan: I'll push PR now as draft. Please leave quick comments in the PR and add ✅ when bench numbers are in. Target merge: EOD Friday if all green.
marta: Ack, will prioritize snippets.
devex-bot: devex-bot: SDK teams notified. Slack thread updated.
eli: Quick follow-up: add a short recommendation box "When to pick q4 vs q8" — 2 bullets: q4 for lower mem, q8 for slightly faster FP on supported GPUs.
sarah: Noted, adding.
chris: One more: add a tiny note about tokenization differences (tokenizer merges) that change reported token counts by ~3% vs older models.
sarah: Good catch. I'll include that under "compatibility: tokenization".
eli: OK — will review PR after benches are attached. Thanks everyone.
sarah: Thanks. Closing loop here until benches + SDK snippet updates are in the PR. :)
